study: Matched SpO2-history / PPG / combined incremental-information experiment
cohort: Existing local BIDMC recording IDs 1..30 only; patient linkage unavailable
primary_target: minimum valid observed SpO2 <=94 in (t,t+30s], including ongoing lows
common_population: Original complete-future-low pulse rows with a valid latest recorded SpO2 at/before t, age <=1.01s; identical rows for every classifier, forecast and fixed reference
history_windows: Inclusive trailing 10/30 seconds at confirmation time; finite observed values only; sample SD; trend OLS on observed times; singleton SD/trend initialized to zero
feature_ablation: SpO2_history vs original PPG10 vs their concatenation; context18 retained historically but not added to this minimal primary study
classifier_parameters: Reuse exact src.config.MODEL_CONFIGS, including imbalance choices and seed42; no hyperparameter search
outer_validation: Leave one recording out, identical held-out rows in all modalities
inner_validation: Three GroupKFold recording partitions, training-only median imputation/scaling/model fitting
alarm_policy: One threshold per outer recording/modality/model selected only from inner OOF scores; maximize training one-to-one event detections subject to both constraints; existing deterministic ties
alarm_budget_note: Single prespecified research operating point, not a clinical standard; no selection among held-out budgets
matching: Existing chronological earliest-unused actual episode start in [onset-30,onset); no reuse or clipped restart
event_exposure: Existing strict current-normal valid <=2s pulse edges with complete future coverage; retrospective evaluability, not a live future-aware gate
sustained_sensitivity: Keep primary labels/fits/cutoffs unchanged; separately score qualifying episodes with >=3 consecutive low readings spanning >=2 seconds; recompute off-event burden using this truth subset
fixed_classification_rule: Future-min forecast <=94; persistence=current; trend=min(current,current+30*past10s_slope), clipped to [0,100]. Fixed references are not budget-selected
forecast_target: Continuous minimum observed SpO2 in the same complete (t,t+30s] window, in percentage points
forecast_output: Clip every forecast to physical [0,100] bounds; preserve raw predictions too
calibration: No fitted calibration. Assess held-out LR/GNB probability-shaped outputs with Brier and reliability bins; explicitly uncalibrated due to weighting/priors. ELM and heuristic scores excluded from probability metrics
bootstrap_unit: Whole recordings, same multiplicities for paired comparisons; conditional on saved overlapping CV fits, not verified patients or refit uncertainty
primary_contrast: Combined minus SpO2_history within each fixed model family at the declared alarm objective; all three families reported, no outer-selected winner
generalization: Exploratory reanalysis of previously examined recordings; no independent confirmatory or patient-level generalization claim
